Author: Mayo Botic
Name: PF Presets
Description: Save and manage Party Finder recruitment presets. Configure duty, objective, roles, conditions, and more - then apply any preset with a single click to instantly set up your Party Finder listing.
Punchline: One-click Party Finder presets. Save your recruitment settings and reuse them instantly.
Changelog: New: community ratings. Rate the people you finish duties with, look up any character by name and world, and see the rating of everyone in your party. A prompt after a duty offers to rate the group, and asks only once. Player profiles show a rating, job, and which duties you have run together - that last part never leaves your client. Party progression shows how far each member has got on savage, ultimate, extreme and criterion fights. You can also report a player to the plugin author, anonymously if you prefer. Ratings are off until you switch them on in Settings, and turning them off again removes every score and stops the plugin contacting the rating server. Presets are unaffected either way.
